Expedition commander

Biography

The Expedition commander leads a Khadaganian expedition on Gipath in search of the fallen meteorite. Instead of the friendly reception promised by the stranded official, Zak receives threats of torture and imprisonment. The Hermit Lizard’s offer provides a way out of the camp. [1, 2, 3, 4]
